Big changes to the convert tab for an improved workflow and consistency across pages
## What's New - Rebuilt the Convert tab around an Analyze + Queue workflow: review one file's settings at a time, then commit it to a reorderable queue - Added a Reveal in Finder button to Bottom Card
## Fixes - The Convert button stays visible at all times, and turns into Cancel All while conversions are running - Fixed missing output size/duration chips for source files ffprobe can't fully read - Fixed a hover-expand bug where icon buttons flickered at their edge and shifted neighboring buttons (Edit no longer moves Remove)

First public release of Drop — a fast, native macOS app for downloading and converting online video and audio using yt-dlp and ffmpeg.
Features: - Paste-and-go downloading with automatic link analysis - Quality selection up to 4K, MP4/MKV output, audio-only extraction - Smart MP4 codec compatibility (avoids VP9/AV1-in-MP4 playback failures) - Menu bar quick paste - Download history with one-click redownload/retry - Self-updating bundled yt-dlp/ffmpeg - In-app self-update via this Releases page
